earnings.title: AUTODESK, INC. ANNOUNCES FISCAL 2027 THIRD QUARTER RESULTS
highlights: Third quarter revenue grew 17 percent year over year as reported, 14 percent on a constant currency basis, to $2.16 billion

quotes.text: As AI becomes more capable and accessible, differentiation will increasingly come from the ability to combine intelligence with trusted engineering capabilities, rich project context and complex industry workflows.
Our third-quarter results reflect the consistent underlying momentum of our business, with continued strength in AEC, particularly construction and emerging markets, alongside strong renewal rates.

outlook: Q4 FY27 GAAP income taxes are expected to include a discrete benefit of approximately $163 million from the release of certain tax reserves.

items.heading: Our strategy to develop and introduce new products and services exposes us to risks such as limited customer acceptance (both with new and existing customers), costs related to product defects, and large expenditures, each of which may result in no additional net revenue or decreased net revenue.
